results.title: milet LIVE at Nippon Budokan 2026「Ray of Water」
results.original_title: milet LIVE at Nippon Budokan 2026「Ray of Water」
results.overview: In February 2026, milet held a concert at the Nippon Budokan, her first performance there in three years. milet named this performance "Ray of Water" with the hope of "bringing a ray of hope to those who watch the live show." Various installations were used to transform the iconic Budokan stage into a fantastic space where light and water intersect and interact. The performance on February 14, 2026 was broadcast exclusively on TBS-1 with all songs uncut. Original behind-the-scenes footage from the program was also included.

results.title: Radiation of the century  - Chernobyl Part I
results.overview: Footage filmed between 2010 and 2026.  On April 26, 1986, Reactor No. 4 at the Chernobyl Nuclear Power Plant near Pripyat, in Soviet Ukraine, exploded, resulting in a Level 7 nuclear disaster, one of the most catastrophic nuclear accidents in human history.  The fire burned for ten days. Carried by atmospheric currents, clouds of radioactive fallout spread across much of Europe, affecting nearly five million people. To this day, nearly 6,300 square kilometers across Russia, Ukraine, and Belarus remain uninhabitable exclusion zones.  The Chernobyl disaster placed enormous strain on the Soviet economy and severely undermined public confidence in its political system. It is widely regarded as one of the final blows that contributed to the collapse of the Soviet Union.
